svg.title: Question authoring and activation flow
svg.desc: Complete authored sections enter a registered draft and pass structural and live source checks before candidate assembly. Independent review creates either a machine-validated rejection report that retains its immutable candidate and returns corrections to a new candidate identity, or a content-bound acceptance record that permits activation.
